phase: complete native vector tasks with PPO backbone

penalty_parameters.interpretation: fixed coefficient on native cost advantage

limits: All77 tasks retained; per-task probe failures block that task, never reduce the denominator.
All8 operational train/save/load gates must pass per host before formal training.
2M is this complete-series training budget; convergence/SOTA and10M extensions are separate unaccepted questions.
No outcome-dependent stopping, retries, checkpoint selection or replacement of existing runs.
Host assignment fixed per task: all methods/seeds of that task use the same host/runtime.
Native expected aggregate-cost benchmark; not a hard-zero or heterogeneous-constraint certificate.
Three epsilon values are candidate operating points; soft/hard endpoint correspondence is not presumed.
Vision/other observation tracks, multi-agent, Isaac and Safety-CHORES remain in parent inventory and require subsequent adapters.
PPO method contrasts are within this cohort. Host/runtime and policy-update differences prevent treating these as trajectory-paired TRPO runs.
CPU workers use available cores; no artificial GPU keepers or changes to VLA allocations.
CPO references belong to the separate frozen TRPO/CPO cohort, not a new same-host PPO endpoint gate.

operational_amendment.distinction: A new PPO backbone cohort. Related TRPO/CPO jobs continue unchanged; these are not retries.
